newsitem.title: UK: Mirror buys 33 mln Midland shares - dealers.
newsitem.headline: Mirror buys 33 mln Midland shares - dealers.

text.p: Mirror Group Plc bought 33 million shares in Midland Independent News Plc through SBC Warburg at 210p a share, dealers said on Friday.
Earlier, Mirror Group said it agreed to buy Midland Independent Newspapers in a deal worth about 297 million stg or 210p/share.
It was not immediately clear whether the shares bought today were part of the 14.9 percent of Midland that the Mirror Group said it agreed to buy when it announced the bid.
Dealers said Mirror's stake was now around 25 percent.
Simon Roberts in SBC Warburg's corporate finance department declined to comment.
